candidates.change_summary: Change increment of proposalCount from pre-increment (proposalCount += 1) to post-increment (proposalCount = proposalCount++) which leaves proposalCount unchanged in Solidity semantics, causing proposalCount to differ after newGrantProposal.
Remove the increment of proposalCount so proposalCount is not increased when creating a new grant proposal.
Increment proposalCount twice (proposalCount += 1 followed by proposalCount += 1) so proposalCount advances by two after the call.
Move the increment to after writing mapPID_grant, so proposalCount observed during emit differs (emit sees incremented or unincremented value depending on move).
